'''Pyrron Nox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]<ref name="SS" /> and [[Merchant/Legends|trader]].<ref name="GG12">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies|story=Advice from Trader Pyrron Nox}}</ref> Nox was friends with fellow spacers [[Faris (spacer)|Faris]] and [[Wrune Tsallin]]; enough so that Tsallin entrusted Nox with renewing his [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] license while he was working for [[Jatayus Outbound]]. During Nox's visit to the BoSS office, Faris told Nox that Jatayus was a front for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Nox didn't believe it, or the rumors that Black Sun was controlled by a [[Xizor/Legends|Dark Prince]]. As Nox attempted to renew Tsallin's license, he learned from the [[Clerk/Legends|clerk]], [[Lommbo]], that Tsallin had been found dead, floating in the [[Ac'fren Spur]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

Nox was also an acquaintance of [[Gideon (spacer)|Gideon]], [[Cleven]], and the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[Keeta]]. When [[Vandolae]], a member of the [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting]] [[Shi'ido]] [[Species/Legends|species]], impersonated Nox, Gideon discovered the ruse and shot the impostor.<ref name="SS" />
